Universal controller layout

Source: CONTROLLERS.md

Shared identifiers map comparable controls to the same ID across controllers. The figure shows these assignments for gamepads, sticks, keypads, and peripherals.

Universal control IDs for gamepads, sticks, keypads, and peripherals

Each recording contains compact columns for its own controls. Use button_layout(movie) to look up their names and shared IDs, and align_buttons() to align input matrices from different controllers.

The getting-started guide shows how to read a recording.
